# Book Export QA

Problem: An author or publishing workflow needs a bounded preflight on page-count and cover geometry before treating a book export as ready.
Pricing: No approved external machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public capability: https://base44.app/api/apps/698c1f429cfd9b61a605bfc7/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs
Human review: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=littlered-kdp-export-qa-machine-v1
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Use when the user says or means:
- check if my book is ready for KDP
- validate my cover dimensions
- audit this paperback export
- is my book file ready to publish
- check page count and cover DPI

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
